# Elijah Paul

Elijah Paul is co-founder of Hot Bot (https://usehotbot.com), agentic trading on Solana, built with @0xWhoismax. Hot Bot joined the ClawPump × Ansem AnsemHack on its final day and co-won. It went live 24 days after they started building. Before Hot Bot he led AI at Gate. He also built GhostOps, his own agent orchestration system, and Monarch Shield, a CI check for x402 agent payments.

X: https://x.com/elijahintek
Canonical site: https://elijahpaul.io
Contact: elijah@elijahpaul.io
GitHub: https://github.com/GhostOpsandCo

## Work

- Monarch Shield: open-source CLI and CI check. It fails the build when x402 agent payment code can pay without a policy check. It does not enforce payments at runtime, prevent fraud, secure wallets or prove compliance.
- Treasury Router: built at Gate. Finds idle capital across a VIP book and preps the client case. A human approves every move. Prototype on dev data. No live client funds, no autonomous execution.
- Venture Labs: dashboard concept on GhostOps. Every venture idea goes intake → research → red team → decision gate → PRD → build → QA → launch. Illustrative, built from internal docs. Not a live product and no customer results claimed.
- Orelis: voice agent for service businesses. Answers inbound calls, qualifies, takes booking requests, hands off to a human. Real telephony, CRM and uptime depend on the final build.
- Team Take Down: creator protection. Private-file cleanup, protected media, watching public sites, evidence and creator-approved takedown support. It does not search the whole internet and can't promise every copy gets removed.
- GridSynapse: compute buying planner. Public pricing and carbon data, deterministic optimizer. Capacity and latency are modeled. It doesn't reserve or spend with providers.
